tagline: Proclaiming Christ, Cultivating Community, Making Disciples

location.arrival: We gather Sunday mornings at 10:45. Come as you are. We'd love for you to feel welcomed, loved, and encouraged to follow Jesus.

planVisit.heading: We'd love to meet you
planVisit.blurb: Let us know you're coming and we'll be looking for you on Sunday morning.

giving.note: Our giving is administered through our sending church, Longview Point Baptist Church in Hernando. Their platform is set up with several different funds, so please be sure to leave the fund selection on "Coldwater Church Plant – Sam Henderson" to ensure that your gifts are allocated properly.
